name: 玛蕾·灰榆

relationships.text: 信任哈伦的手艺，却总要求他把预算拆开说明，两人争的是修桥先后而非桥该不该修。
relationships.en_text: Trusts Harren’s workmanship but asks for itemized estimates; their dispute concerns repair order, not whether repairs matter.

relationships.text: 让特温核查重复粮票，也担心他把自己的缓税旧账混进当前案件。
relationships.en_text: Assigned Tewin the duplicate-receipt inquiry and fears her unrelated deferral being swept into it.

relationships.text: 在芙岚店里谈过难民免桥费，欠她一顿从未吃完的冷汤。
relationships.en_text: Discussed refugee exemptions at Furran’s inn and owes her for a bowl left cold.

en_role: Mayor and part-owner of a dyehouse
appearance: 袖口常染靛青，木杖磨得发亮。
en_appearance: Indigo stains her cuffs; her walking stick is polished by use.
voice: 先复述对方的问题，再把算盘推过去。
en_voice: Repeats a question before sliding over her abacus.
goal: 让冬季免桥费与桥工薪水同时有着落。
en_goal: Fund winter toll exemptions without cutting bridge wages.
public: 每周主持公开议事；赞成公开账目，却容忍熟商队赊费。
en_public: Chairs public meetings; supports open accounts but lets familiar caravans defer tolls.
private: 她曾替姐姐的染坊缓征一季税，尚未补办回避记录；须查到旧议事簿并给她解释机会，才会承认。
en_private: Deferred her sister’s dyehouse tax without recording her conflict; admits it if shown the old minutes and allowed to explain.
access: 午后在议事厅接见镇民与外来人，争议要排队陈述。
en_access: Receives locals and strangers at the hall in the afternoon; complaints take their turn.

name: 芙岚·铜匙

relationships.text: 肯借玛蕾桌子开会，但要求镇长别把客人的住宿身份写进公开会议名单。
relationships.en_text: Lends Marelle meeting tables but insists guests’ lodging details stay off public attendance lists.

relationships.text: 教塔莎算厨房损耗，愿留她做主管，也知道不能以收留之恩阻止她开店。
relationships.en_text: Teaches Tasha kitchen costs and would keep her as manager, without using past hospitality to stop her opening a business.

relationships.text: 给哈伦的夜班工留热汤，已经提醒他不能再让学徒以赊饭抵欠薪。
relationships.en_text: Keeps soup for Harren’s night crew and warns against substituting meal credit for unpaid wages.

appearance: 红褐辫子夹着账签，一条腿装有皮护具。
en_appearance: Ledger slips pin her auburn braid; a leather brace supports one leg.
voice: 骂人像报菜名，安慰时反而很轻。
en_voice: Scolds like reading a menu, but comforts softly.
goal: 还清面粉债，保住不按族属分桌的客栈。
en_goal: Clear her flour debt and keep the inn’s mixed tables.
public: 能安排床位、洗衣和带薪厨房活；爱留客，却不容客人窥探房间。
en_public: Offers beds, laundry and paid kitchen work; hospitable but fierce about room privacy.
private: 她给一位旧仇之子留了无偿床位，怕老战友发现；只在当事人同意且信任建立后说明。
en_private: Houses the son of an old enemy without charge; explains only with his consent and earned trust.
access: 开门时可在柜台交谈，忙饭点请等到收碗后。
en_access: Available at the counter when open; wait until dishes are cleared during meals.

name: 特温·折笔

relationships.text: 尊重玛蕾肯公开接质询，仍坚持她的亲属不能免于票据复核。
relationships.en_text: Respects Marelle’s public questioning but insists her relatives’ receipts also be checked.

relationships.text: 发现赫莎一张运票编号重复，请她保留原件而不是先认定她骗税。
relationships.en_text: Found a duplicate number on Hesha’s freight slip and requested the original without presuming fraud.

relationships.text: 曾与索缇对过一次粮车重量，双方各保有对方签字的副页。
relationships.en_text: Once reconciled wagon weights with Soti; each retains a countersigned copy.

appearance: 短外套装满票夹，左耳戴铅笔环。
en_appearance: Receipt clips fill his coat; a pencil loop hangs from his left ear.
voice: 数字说得飞快，人名总再问一次。
en_voice: Rattles off figures but asks twice for names.
goal: 找清重复粮票是誊错还是骗税。
en_goal: Establish whether duplicate grain receipts mean error or fraud.
public: 按班领取薪水，擅长比对纸张；极怕误伤小贩，却对大户说话发硬。
en_public: A salaried clerk skilled with paper; fears hurting small traders and speaks sharply to wealthy ones.
private: 一张问题票有他的签字，他确实漏验过印模，但不知道货物后来去哪；核到原票后才愿详述。
en_private: Signed one disputed receipt after missing a seal check; does not know where its cargo went and explains only when the original is found.
access: 白日关台办理事务，私人询问需等交班。
en_access: At the toll desk by day; personal questions wait for shift change.

name: 欧沙·苇桨

relationships.text: 给哈伦运木收友情价，但不肯为抢工期冒洪水风险。
relationships.en_text: Offers Harren friendly timber rates but will not risk floodwater to meet his deadline.

relationships.text: 请乌蒙解释浑水会不会伤鱼，不愿仅凭矿城名声就停掉全部木运。
relationships.en_text: Asks Umon about fish risk rather than stopping all timber work on Copperback’s reputation.

appearance: 湿毛在颈侧卷起，手腕绕三圈测深绳。
en_appearance: Damp neck fur curls above three coils of sounding line.
voice: 爱用水势比喻，但报价毫不含糊。
en_voice: Uses river metaphors, but quotes prices plainly.
goal: 在不堵鱼汛的前提下多运一趟木料。
en_goal: Carry another timber load without blocking the fish run.
public: 卖渡运和领航服务；愿救落水者，却讨厌被当成随叫随到的免费船。
en_public: Sells passage and pilotage; rescues swimmers but resents being treated as a free boat.
private: 曾把一捆无标木料拖上岸保住船底，留有切断的绳头；须共同核查打捞地点才交出。
en_private: Cut loose unmarked timber to save her hull and kept the rope end; shares it after a joint inspection of the recovery site.
access: 渡船靠岸时可谈，航行中听从安全安排。
en_access: Speak while the ferry is moored; follow safety directions aboard.

name: 艾汀·石麦

relationships.text: 盼格兰先修自家支渠，又承认主闸不修所有田都缺水。
relationships.en_text: Wants Grelan to fix his branch first, while recognizing every field needs the headgate.

relationships.text: 怕洁珊的歉收表让自己借不到种粮，仍愿在有人解释用途后核实数字。
relationships.en_text: Fears Jeshan’s loss report will block seed credit, but will verify figures when their purpose is clear.

appearance: 左手缺两指，种袋上缝着褪色军布。
en_appearance: Two fingers are missing; faded uniform cloth patches his seed bag.
voice: 先抱怨天气，随后给出很实际的办法。
en_voice: Complains about weather before offering practical solutions.
goal: 修好共用渠，同时不丢掉最后一块租田。
en_goal: Repair the shared ditch without losing his last rented field.
public: 靠种麦与修篱笆过活；主张分担劳动，又不愿别人看见伤手撑不住锹。
en_public: Farms and mends fences; demands shared labor but hides how his injured hand struggles with a spade.
private: 租约口头承诺和纸契不同，他把纸契藏在粮罐下；只有允许他自己取出才可核实。
en_private: His written lease differs from the oral promise; he keeps it under a grain jar and must choose to show it.
access: 晴日田边可见，付工钱或换工皆可商量。
en_access: Found in the fields in fair weather; paid or exchanged labor can be discussed.

name: 瑟梨·白砾

relationships.text: 愿替赫莎送急信，但坚持夜班另配同行，宁可少赚也不假装不怕。
relationships.en_text: Carries Hesha’s urgent letters but insists on company at night rather than pretending fearlessness.

relationships.text: 请卡鲁留意失联信使的马，不允许他因替班人害怕就当作嫌疑。
relationships.en_text: Asks Karru to watch for the missing courier’s horse without treating fear as guilt.

appearance: 靴帮补了四种皮，额前有被头盔压平的卷发。
en_appearance: Four kinds of leather patch her boots; helmet-flattened curls frame her brow.
voice: 背路线极流畅，问到夜路就慢下来。
en_voice: Recites routes fluently, then slows at questions about night travel.
goal: 找回失联前辈，并争取两人同行的夜班。
en_goal: Find the missing senior courier and secure paired night shifts.
public: 收取明码信资；很想独当一面，又不肯拿害怕当作必须证明的羞耻。
en_public: Charges posted rates; wants independence but refuses to treat fear as shame.
private: 她曾在夜路听见求救却先撤回驿站，之后带人折返；查看值班簿并不等于知道求救者是谁。
en_private: Retreated from a cry at night, then returned with help; the shift book does not identify who cried out.
access: 白天分拣信件时接待，不能拆看他人信封。
en_access: Available during daytime sorting; other people’s envelopes remain private.

name: 蕾萨·白刺

relationships.text: 依赖布洛教活人回家，却烦恼他的停训建议会让护送缺人。
relationships.en_text: Relies on Brullo to bring trainees home alive, yet his training pauses leave escorts understaffed.

relationships.text: 把难堪的粮数交索缇核，要求先区分账误与真实亏空。
relationships.en_text: Gives Soti embarrassing grain figures and asks that clerical errors be separated from actual shortages.

relationships.text: 与梅荻争过冬草，愿谈分区轮牧，不接受把全部军马都赶走。
relationships.en_text: Disputed winter grass with Medi; accepts rotational zones but not removing every military horse.

appearance: 短灰发，胸甲的旧裂口用异色铁补过。
en_appearance: Cropped gray hair; mismatched iron repairs an old breastplate crack.
voice: 命令简短，谈粮食时逐项问清。
en_voice: Gives brief orders and asks detailed questions about provisions.
goal: 守住停战道路，不让军户替骑士挨饿。
en_goal: Hold the truce roads without starving military households.
public: 以护送收入维持驻军；愿受公开质询，但不轻易承认部署失误。
en_public: Funds troops through escorts; accepts public questions but struggles to admit tactical errors.
private: 她已准备削减自己的卫队口粮，却尚未找到替代补给；获得军需谈判资格后可见草案，不代表计划已经执行。
en_private: Drafted cuts to her own guard’s rations without securing replacements; authorized supply negotiators may see the unimplemented draft.
access: 每日晚钟后设接见时段，紧急路情可经卫兵通报。
en_access: Holds audiences after evening bell; guards relay urgent road reports.

name: 布洛·止刃

relationships.text: 承认蕾萨的补给压力，仍拒绝让未学会停手的人仅凭名额出勤。
relationships.en_text: Recognizes Ressa’s supply pressure but refuses to deploy trainees who cannot stop on command.

relationships.text: 看见艾梵的勇气，也盯着他是否真正听停手口令；不以身高判断潜力。
relationships.en_text: Sees Ayvan’s courage and tests his stopping discipline, not his height.

relationships.text: 把需要修的练甲交奥芙处理，愿以教学抵部分工钱但从不自行决定抵扣。
relationships.en_text: Sends practice armor to Ovv and offers lessons in barter, never assumes the exchange.

role: 演武教头兼甲具修理师
appearance: 胡须扎成平结，练剑刃口包软皮。
en_appearance: A flat knot binds his beard; soft leather wraps his practice blade.
voice: 从不高喊勇敢，只问谁还站得稳。
en_voice: Never shouts for courage; asks who can still stand steadily.
goal: 让学员学会撤退、停手与照看伤员。
en_goal: Teach retreat, restraint and care for the wounded.
public: 收少量学费，也接受修器换课；讨厌炫技，自己却爱赢棋。
en_public: Takes modest fees or repairs in exchange for lessons; dislikes showing off but hates losing at board games.
private: 早年一次追击命令害死同伴，他保存了当时的停战旗；建立师徒信任后才讲，遗物不自动证明全部责任。
en_private: An old pursuit order of his killed comrades; he keeps the truce flag and speaks after trust, though it cannot prove every detail.
access: 晨练和公开课可旁听，实操先约定护具与停手信号。
en_access: Visitors may watch morning drills; practical lessons require protection and a stop signal.

name: 伊芮·无铃

relationships.text: 与乔文合作核名，反对为了等全部证据而让遗体长期无人照料。
relationships.en_text: Works with Joven on names but rejects leaving bodies uncared for while all evidence is sought.

relationships.text: 请索缇先给无名死者留编号，再逐项补身份，双方仍争取证时限。
relationships.en_text: Asks Soti to number the unnamed first and add identities later; they still dispute inquiry time.

appearance: 颈上只有空铃架，指甲染着防腐草汁。
en_appearance: An empty bell frame hangs at their neck; preserving herbs stain their nails.
voice: 称呼逝者前会留一段沉默。
en_voice: Leaves a silence before speaking a dead person’s name.
goal: 安葬无名者，同时不抹去日后辨认的机会。
en_goal: Bury the unnamed while preserving chances of later identification.
public: 主持不同信仰的葬礼，以抄书补收入；宽待哀伤，不宽待草率的身份断言。
en_public: Conducts funerals across faiths and copies books for income; patient with grief, impatient with careless identifications.
private: 曾把一具遗体误记成另一人，已留更正封页；家属允许或正式核名时方能阅看。
en_private: Once misidentified a body and kept a sealed correction; access needs family consent or a legitimate identification inquiry.
access: 礼拜堂无仪式时接待，葬礼中不接受打断。
en_access: Receives visitors between ceremonies, not during funerals.

name: 卡鲁·红砂

relationships.text: 相信瑟梨熟悉驿马习性，邀请她在安全地点核对鞍具，而不是带她盲闯隘口。
relationships.en_text: Values Serri’s knowledge of post horses and offers safe tack identification rather than a blind pass search.

relationships.text: 带艾梵做过一趟短途巡路，要求他报告路况而非编英雄故事。
relationships.en_text: Took Ayvan on a short patrol and asked for road conditions, not heroic tales.

relationships.text: 愿帮温娅查马蹄痕，承认笔迹不是自己的专长。
relationships.en_text: Offers Wenya help with hoofprints and admits handwriting is not his expertise.

appearance: 暗铜鳞磨出浅斑，马鞍挂着兽医剪。
en_appearance: Pale wear marks his copper scales; veterinary shears hang from his saddle.
voice: 与马说话温柔，对人先问手续。
en_voice: Gentle with horses, procedural with people.
goal: 找回失马，阻止误扣合法车队。
en_goal: Recover stolen horses without impounding lawful caravans.
public: 靠军饷养两匹退役马；反对族群偏见，却容易先疑虑衣着破旧者。
en_public: Uses his pay to keep two retired horses; opposes ethnic prejudice yet distrusts shabby travelers too quickly.
private: 他认出一枚失马烙号曾被合法转卖，未查清前不愿公开指人；查到售据才可共同判断。
en_private: Recognizes one brand from a lawful sale and will not name suspects before tracing its receipt.
access: 路检时可交涉，搜查争议可要求在场证人。
en_access: Available at the checkpoint; disputed searches may have witnesses.

name: 梅荻·长草

relationships.text: 记得蕾萨曾派人救病羊，仍认为那不能抵消军队今年占草场的影响。
relationships.en_text: Remembers Ressa’s help with sick goats but will not let it erase this year’s military grazing impact.

relationships.text: 请艾弥教自己辨认需要送诊的牲畜接触后不适，不把人医当万能兽医。
relationships.en_text: Asks Aimi about human illness after animal contact, without treating her as an all-purpose veterinarian.

relationships.text: 肯帮温娅分清羊蹄与马蹄，也要求她听牧人对巡路规则的意见。
relationships.en_text: Helps Wenya distinguish goat and horse tracks and wants her to hear herders on patrol rules.

appearance: 折角包着铜箍，披肩有奶酪盐粒。
en_appearance: A copper hoop braces a broken horn; cheese salt dusts her shawl.
voice: 耐心讲三遍，第四遍会直接牵羊离开。
en_voice: Explains patiently three times, then takes her goats away.
goal: 给病羊留越冬草地，又不让堡中役畜饿死。
en_goal: Keep winter grazing for sick goats without starving the keep’s draft animals.
public: 靠奶酪和引牧挣钱；支持共享草场，也会为自家先留一小片。
en_public: Sells cheese and guiding; favors shared pasture but reserves a patch for her own herd.
private: 她的羊病与污染可能有关，但尚无诊断；只向能保密的照料者展示记录，不把猜测当事实。
en_private: Suspects polluted water in the herd’s illness without a diagnosis; shares notes with trusted carers, not accusations.
access: 早晚挤奶后可谈，入群须先让牧犬熟悉气味。
en_access: Talk after morning or evening milking; let the dogs learn a visitor’s scent first.

name: 乔文·残旗

relationships.text: 信任伊芮认真安葬，也要求墓位与更正记录始终能够对应。
relationships.en_text: Trusts Irei’s funeral care and insists grave locations remain linked to corrected records.

relationships.text: 希望塞维娅辨纸墨，也提醒她墓主家属的话不该仅因无字据就被忽略。
relationships.en_text: Wants Sevia’s paper expertise and reminds her not to dismiss families without written proof.

en_role: Crypt keeper and inscription rubbings maker
appearance: 右肩低垂，腰带插着软刷与蜡纸。
en_appearance: One shoulder droops; brushes and wax paper line his belt.
voice: 语气平常，提起军官头衔就带刺。
en_voice: Speaks plainly, with an edge for officers’ titles.
goal: 保住葬名册，使家属能查而不被买走。
en_goal: Keep burial registers accessible to families rather than buyers.
public: 收清扫和拓片工钱；尊重墓主，却不认为贵族墓比无名坑更重要。
en_public: Charges for cleaning and rubbings; respects graves without privileging noble tombs.
private: 他发现名册夹有军需账，但只读过外页；先证明查阅理由、安排保全后才展示，不能替内页作证。
en_private: Found supply accounts inside a burial register but read only the outer leaf; requires a reason and preservation plan before showing it.
access: 日间在入口接待，深处须备灯并避开不稳石阶。
en_access: At the entrance by day; deeper visits need lamps and stable footing.

name: 诺缇·草响

relationships.text: 与维斯听过不同方向的声响，不肯让他把自己不曾走过的路线说成亲眼所见。
relationships.en_text: Heard sounds from another direction than Viss and will not let him claim her untraveled route as his observation.

relationships.text: 给伊佐供野生种子，要求保留采集地的使用约定，不愿稀有草被一棚买断。
relationships.en_text: Supplies Izo wild seed under collection agreements rather than an exclusive claim to rare plants.

appearance: 宽帽挂着辨草木片，膝上有新泥。
en_appearance: Her broad hat carries plant markers; fresh mud marks her knees.
voice: 描述气味极准，却记不住贵人头衔。
en_voice: Precise about scents, forgetful about titles.
goal: 弄清林口钟声而不耽误药草生意。
en_goal: Explain the bell sound without neglecting herb sales.
public: 可带路和教辨认常见草；好奇心强，见危险却会及时返程。
en_public: Guides and teaches common herbs; curious but willing to turn back.
private: 她听见的声响来自一条私采小径，担心暴露后失去采集权；达成不公开路线的约定才肯带看。
en_private: Heard the sound from an unofficial gathering path; shows it only after agreement not to publicize the route.
access: 晴天早晨林口篮摊可见，入林另约时长与报酬。
en_access: Sells baskets at the verge on clear mornings; forest trips need agreed time and pay.

name: 萨蕾温·根结

relationships.text: 邀请哈伦看病根桥，愿试石撑，但要求先听当地渡桥人的意见。
relationships.en_text: Invites Harren to inspect the root bridge and consider stone supports after hearing local users.

relationships.text: 与欧瑞娅争过祖牌是否能暂移，认同先做完整记录再谈工程。
relationships.en_text: Disputed temporary plaque removal with Oreya and agrees to record them before planning work.

appearance: 银发裹在工作巾里，掌心有新锯伤。
en_appearance: Silver hair stays under a work scarf; a fresh saw cut crosses her palm.
voice: 先问桥给谁走，再问桥该怎么修。
en_voice: Asks who uses a bridge before asking how to mend it.
goal: 让病根恢复承重，给外来石匠公平试作的机会。
en_goal: Restore the failing root span and give outside masons a fair trial.
public: 靠修木构生活；守护旧俗，却坚持旧俗必须容得下活人过河。
en_public: Repairs timber buildings; values custom but insists living people must still cross.
private: 她早已私下试过石支墩，怕议者觉得程序被绕过；查看施工痕迹后可质问，不能凭年龄猜到。
en_private: Secretly tested a stone support and fears accusations of bypassing the council; the work marks can prompt questions.
access: 每日巡桥时可同行，议事需等公开场合。
en_access: Visitors can accompany her bridge inspection; council business waits for a public meeting.

name: 乌蒙·泉砂

relationships.text: 需要欧沙带去上游采样；会付航费，也不要求她替尚未证实的结论作证。
relationships.en_text: Needs Osha for upstream sampling, pays passage and does not demand testimony to unproven conclusions.

relationships.text: 请多茵提供洗矿排水图，尚未据此认定所有浑水来自矿城。
relationships.en_text: Requests Doyin’s drainage plans without presuming all turbidity comes from the mines.

relationships.text: 赞成杜埃小规模试采，要求把失败和好结果一起记录。
relationships.en_text: Supports Due’s small trials and requires failures recorded with successes.

role: 泉水守护者与样本记录员
appearance: 短须沾着白泥，每只水瓶都有布签。
en_appearance: White clay marks his short beard; cloth tags label every bottle.
voice: 不接激烈指控，只追问取样时辰。
en_voice: Answers accusations by asking when samples were drawn.
goal: 查出泉水混浊的源头，让补救针对真实原因。
en_goal: Trace the spring’s turbidity so remedies address its real cause.
public: 替聚落维护水路并教授自然感知；坚守证据，有时让受害者觉得冷淡。
en_public: Maintains channels and teaches natural awareness; his insistence on evidence can feel cold to sufferers.
private: 首批样本有一瓶标签掉落，他拒绝把它当确证；共同整理样本时会说明，不能因此说其他样本全假。
en_private: One early bottle lost its label; he excludes it and explains during a joint review without discrediting all samples.
access: 午后在泉旁整理瓶具，取水须避免踩坏采样点。
en_access: Sorts bottles beside the spring in the afternoon; avoid disturbing sampling points.

name: 贝珂·杂袋

relationships.text: 向缪特买过锁具出处鉴别，知道他收费高却没有把每件失物都当赃物。
relationships.en_text: Bought lock provenance checks from Myut, who charged well without calling every lost object stolen.

relationships.text: 给乔露修过花车，约好用三场婚礼的鲜花抵工而非无限欠人情。
relationships.en_text: Repaired Jolu’s flower cart for flowers at three weddings, not an unlimited favor.

appearance: 马甲口袋大小不一，指头绕着彩线。
en_appearance: Uneven pockets cover their vest; colored thread winds around their fingers.
voice: 每件旧物都有一段故事，但会承认故事未必真。
en_voice: Offers a story for every object and admits it may be wrong.
goal: 辨明摊上失物来源，保住买卖信誉。
en_goal: Trace suspicious goods and preserve their trading reputation.
public: 收旧物、补锅补袋；相信再利用，却舍不得退还一笔已付出的收购钱。
en_public: Buys used goods and repairs pots and bags; values reuse but hates losing purchase money.
private: 可疑货的卖家是欠他们钱的熟人；只有出示相符失物描述、允许当面核对后才透露交易细节。
en_private: The seller of suspicious goods is a debtor they know; matching descriptions and a fair verification process precede disclosure.
access: 集日摊位可见，非集日可托邻摊约修补。
en_access: At the fair on market days; neighboring stalls can arrange repairs otherwise.

name: 维斯·泥靴

relationships.text: 认为诺缇懂干地草却未必懂泥底，愿陪她复查但要求系绳。
relationships.en_text: Trusts Noti’s herbs more than her mud judgment; will help recheck if she uses a rope.

relationships.text: 请赫里教新的绳结，羡慕他能按潮位定时收工。
relationships.en_text: Asks Herri for new knots and envies his tide-defined stopping times.

appearance: 衣袖卷得很高，背着锈铜和软木浮片。
en_appearance: High-rolled sleeves expose a load of rusted copper and cork floats.
voice: 嘴上说不信怪事，下水前总轻碰旧钟。
en_voice: Claims disbelief in omens, yet touches the bell before entering water.
goal: 挣到修屋钱，不让捞铜的人陷进淤泥。
en_goal: Earn roof money and keep copper salvagers out of lethal mud.
public: 出售合法废料和沼路经验；敢冒险，但拒带无绳的新手下水。
en_public: Sells lawful scrap and marsh expertise; takes risks but refuses unroped beginners.
private: 他拆过一块钟托，发现木桩因此松动，正在凑钱补回；只有看到损痕或取得信任才承认。
en_private: Removed a bell brace and loosened a piling; saving to replace it, he admits it when shown the damage or after trust.
access: 在干岸分拣废料时可见，深入沼地需约潮水与装备。
en_access: Found sorting scrap on firm ground; deeper trips require water-level and equipment planning.

name: 欧瑞娅·叶铭

relationships.text: 知道萨蕾温不是轻视旧史，仍坚持桥修完后必须有明确归还位置。
relationships.en_text: Knows Sarewyn values history and insists repaired bridges have defined places for returned plaques.

relationships.text: 愿替瑟缇拓祖牌，却希望她也读完牌上邻族的名字。
relationships.en_text: Offers Seti plaque copies and asks her to read the neighboring people’s names too.

en_role: Keeper of the grove’s memory plaques
appearance: 斗篷绣着不同村落的针法，耳后别骨笔。
en_appearance: Her cloak bears stitches from several villages; a bone stylus rests behind her ear.
voice: 背旧名很快，谈自己的旧名很慢。
en_voice: Recites old names quickly and her own former name slowly.
goal: 保存混居史，也让失土家庭有可以带走的纪念。
en_goal: Preserve shared settlement history while giving displaced families portable memorials.
public: 靠刻牌与照料树庭生活；反对抢走祖牌，却愿教人做拓本。
en_public: Earns through carving and tending the grove; opposes taking ancestral plaques but teaches copying.
private: 她自己的家族也曾驱逐邻户，牌背留有记载；需获准翻检背铭，不能只凭正面颂辞认定清白。
en_private: Her family once expelled neighbors, recorded on a plaque’s reverse; the reverse must be inspected with permission rather than assuming innocence from its praise.
access: 清理落叶时可请教，移动牌位需另征同意。
en_access: Available while clearing leaves; moving a plaque requires separate consent.

name: 多茵·炉脊

relationships.text: 愿和乌蒙同步采样，但要求不同时间的瓶子不能直接当成同一批水。
relationships.en_text: Will coordinate sampling with Umon but insists bottles from different times not be treated as one water batch.

relationships.text: 和博岑排过病房净水优先次序，双方都反对先修门面工程。
relationships.en_text: Agrees with Bozen that ward water precedes decorative projects.

relationships.text: 对阿莎的实地记录有兴趣，愿给有限意见而不装作看过宫底。
relationships.en_text: Values Asha’s field notes and offers bounded advice without pretending to have seen the palace floor.

relationships.text: 认可格兰把结构问题与传说分开，准备先核高差而非研究骨名。
relationships.en_text: Values Grelan’s separation of engineering and legend; starts with levels, not bone names.

appearance: 铜尺比首饰多，双眼常因熬夜发红。
en_appearance: Wears more measuring tools than jewelry; sleeplessness reddens her eyes.
voice: 一说管径就忘了客套。
en_voice: Forgets pleasantries when discussing pipe diameters.
goal: 先把净水送到工人病房，再改主街喷泉。
en_goal: Supply clean water to the workers’ ward before rebuilding the main fountain.
public: 靠工程费和维护薪水生活；厌恶排场，却渴望一座刻自己名字的水塔。
en_public: Lives on engineering fees and maintenance pay; despises pomp but wants her name on a water tower.
private: 一段私宅供水旁路是她早年设计，现可转给病房；查到图纸才会解释产权阻碍。
en_private: Designed a private water bypass that could now serve the ward; the plans reveal both the option and its ownership obstacle.
access: 早班在配水台接待，带上用水位置比带荐信有效。
en_access: At the water desk early; a service address helps more than a recommendation.

name: 赫德兰·铜衡

relationships.text: 扶持涅拉参与议事，也担心她用个人担保掩盖家族共有账的问题。
relationships.en_text: Supports Nera’s council role but fears personal pledges masking shared financial trouble.

relationships.text: 认为博岑是难谈却必须认真对待的代表，不接受用请吃饭替代工资协商。
relationships.en_text: Finds Bozen difficult but essential; a meal cannot substitute for wage talks.

role: 炉家代理人与契约调停者
appearance: 戒指悬在颈链上，工作时不戴手套。
en_appearance: Carries signet rings on a neck chain and works barehanded.
voice: 先讲祖契，最后却常问实际要多少。
en_voice: Begins with ancestral covenants and ends by asking the real price.
goal: 用共同分担通风费阻止诸家拆伙。
en_goal: Keep the houses together through shared ventilation costs.
public: 收调停佣金；珍惜契约，也清楚旧契从未问过工人的意见。
en_public: Takes mediation fees; values contracts while knowing old ones excluded workers.
private: 他所属家族的储金比公开账薄少，继续扩井会危及欠薪支付；经正式财务授权才可核阅底账。
en_private: His house has less reserve cash than public books imply; expansion threatens wages, discoverable only through authorized accounts.
access: 议厅开放日受理陈情，私账不随接见开放。
en_access: Receives petitions on open days; an audience does not open private accounts.

name: 凯莎·风轮

relationships.text: 依赖博岑报告支架状况，也害怕他公开质疑会让自己丢掉奖金。
relationships.en_text: Relies on Bozen’s support reports and fears his public criticism costing her bonus.

relationships.text: 催涅拉交付风轮备件，要求看到到货日期而不是继承庆典上的承诺。
relationships.en_text: Presses Nera for fan delivery dates rather than ceremonial promises.

appearance: 面罩内侧补软布，毛发积着黑矿尘。
en_appearance: Soft cloth lines her mask; dark ore dust clings to her fur.
voice: 平时干脆，听到头痛报告便反复确认。
en_voice: Usually brisk, she asks repeated questions about reported headaches.
goal: 修复风轮又保住工人停产期间的收入。
en_goal: Repair the fan and protect workers’ pay during shutdown.
public: 按产量领奖金，因此迟疑停工；却会亲自下去接落后者。
en_public: Receives production bonuses and hesitates to halt work, yet retrieves stragglers herself.
private: 她已经登记过两次头晕，只把程度写轻了；工人自愿提供记录并交叉核验后才能坐实。
en_private: Understated two dizziness reports; voluntary worker records and cross-checks can establish this.
access: 交班时在井口，井下问话须先满足安全条件。
en_access: At the shaft mouth during shift change; underground interviews require safe conditions.

name: 杜埃·盐纹

relationships.text: 向贝琳供药盐，要求她说明纯度需求，好避免浪费地下资源。
relationships.en_text: Supplies Belin with medicinal salt and asks for purity requirements to avoid waste.

relationships.text: 请乌蒙帮追地下水流向，担心被误当作矿城的免责专家。
relationships.en_text: Asks Umon to trace underground flow without becoming an excuse for the mines.

appearance: 淡灰鳞隙积着晶粉，工具柄包旧帆布。
en_appearance: Crystal dust fills pale scale seams; old sailcloth wraps his tools.
voice: 下刀前不说话，收工后能聊很久。
en_voice: Silent before a cut, talkative after work.
goal: 找到低扰动采法，让药用盐不耗尽地下河。
en_goal: Develop gentler extraction that supplies medicine without draining the underground river.
public: 按合格晶块计酬；愿少采一些，却怕学徒学会后压低他的工价。
en_public: Paid per sound crystal; accepts lower yields but fears apprentices undercutting his rates.
private: 他保留一块会裂的试样，尚不确定原因；获准参观试切后才能知道失败，不可当成成熟技术。
en_private: Keeps a failing test sample without knowing why it splits; a permitted test visit reveals a failure, not a proven technique.
access: 洞外切台预约试工，洞内禁止随意敲击。
en_access: Trial work can be booked at the outer bench; no casual striking inside the cave.

name: 奥芙·冷锤

relationships.text: 认可布洛会保护学员，仍要求他别把训练日改动变成工坊无偿加班。
relationships.en_text: Values Brullo’s care for students but will not let altered drill schedules create unpaid overtime.

relationships.text: 给提路修测绘工具，允许分期，条件是不要把未测路段画成已通。
relationships.en_text: Repairs Tiru’s tools on installments provided unmeasured routes are not presented as open.

appearance: 右眉被火烧去一截，围裙写着粉笔工期。
en_appearance: A burn interrupts one eyebrow; chalk deadlines cover her apron.
voice: 报价直说，夸奖绕着说。
en_voice: Direct about prices and indirect about praise.
goal: 在军单与农具之间排出不误春耕的工期。
en_goal: Schedule military orders without delaying spring farm tools.
public: 接受按工序学艺和维修；反对欠薪，自己却常忘记给自己放假。
en_public: Teaches by actual stages and takes repairs; opposes unpaid labor but seldom lets herself rest.
private: 一批旧军单拖欠的并非军队，而是私人中间商；出示订单往来后才可分清债务。
en_private: A private intermediary, not the army, owes an old military order; correspondence is needed to establish the debtor.
access: 炉火稳定时可在外柜谈，锻造时不能闯工作区。
en_access: Talk at the outer counter between heats; do not enter active forging space.

name: 提路·轨灯

relationships.text: 欠奥芙工具钱，想用复轨后的运费优惠抵债，但知道必须先取得她同意。
relationships.en_text: Owes Ovv for tools and hopes future hauling discounts can repay her, only by agreement.

relationships.text: 盼涅拉支持旧轨复通，又怕她只准矿车使用。
relationships.en_text: Hopes Nera funds reopening and fears ore-only access.

appearance: 腰带吊着彩色定位钉，灯罩补了三处。
en_appearance: Colored survey pins hang from his belt; his lamp has three patches.
voice: 报距离一丝不苟，讲梦想一下放大十倍。
en_voice: Exact with distances, extravagant with dreams.
goal: 重开旧轨运送日用品，而非只给矿石让路。
en_goal: Reopen the railway for daily goods as well as ore.
public: 靠测绘拿工钱；愿教识图，急于出名时会低估谈地权的时间。
en_public: Paid for surveying and willing to teach; ambition makes him underestimate land negotiations.
private: 他从未测完坍塌后的最后一段，却在草图画了虚线推测；看原图才知其未证实。
en_private: Never surveyed the last collapsed stretch and drew a conjectural dotted route; only the original marks it as uncertain.
access: 轨口工作棚可约，深入隧道须先检查支撑。
en_access: Appointments at the railhead shed; supports must be checked before entering.

name: 缇瑟·鱼鳞

relationships.text: 愿让梅洛上自家船测水，要求先用渔户听得懂的话解释封湖。
relationships.en_text: Lets Melo survey from her boat if closures are explained plainly to fishers.

relationships.text: 靠娜维运鱼箱，主张鲜鱼优先卸，却接受不能擅挪别人的封箱。
relationships.en_text: Uses Navi for fish crates and requests quick unloading without moving others’ sealed cargo.

appearance: 袖上缝鱼骨纹，手背有旧网绳痕。
en_appearance: Fishbone stitches mark her sleeves; old net burns cross her hands.
voice: 不反对难词，但要人解释两次。
en_voice: Does not reject technical words, but asks for two explanations.
goal: 让封湖范围和补偿按实测数据说明白。
en_goal: Get survey-based closure boundaries and clear compensation.
public: 卖鱼并代邻船议价；尊重知识，又忍不住把学者的小错说得很响。
en_public: Sells fish and bargains for neighboring boats; respects learning but broadcasts scholars’ minor errors.
private: 她自家船越过过一次临时禁线，带回的样本可能有价值；保障公平处理后才愿交船记。
en_private: Her own boat crossed a temporary boundary once and brought back a useful sample; she offers its log after fair treatment is assured.
access: 清晨鱼市可谈交易，午后码头可谈湖事。
en_access: Trade at the morning fish market; discuss lake affairs at the quay in the afternoon.

name: 艾洛温·铜环

relationships.text: 与瓦瑟共同校图多年，怕对方把自己的错误当作进一步封存的理由。
relationships.en_text: Has collated charts with Vasser for years and fears his error becoming grounds for wider restrictions.

relationships.text: 知道塔芙需要可信航图，愿提供复核记录但暂不能解释古灯全部原理。
relationships.en_text: Knows Tavv needs reliable charts; offers review records, not a complete beacon explanation.

appearance: 镜片厚薄不一，袖口烫有小星图。
en_appearance: Mismatched lenses and a tiny star chart pressed into his cuff.
voice: 公开讲课从容，遇到反证就清嗓子。
en_voice: Poised in lectures, throat-clearing when contradicted.
goal: 修正航用星图，同时让学徒不因老师的错误失去资助。
en_goal: Correct navigation charts without costing apprentices their funding.
public: 靠教学与航图订阅生活；倡导检验，面对自己旧著却很防御。
en_public: Lives on teaching and chart subscriptions; praises testing but defends his old book.
private: 误差由他早年抄错一位数字扩大；需比对亲笔稿和观测记录后才足以认定，初见不会自白。
en_private: An early copied digit of his amplified the error; manuscript and observation comparison are required, not an instant confession.
access: 每旬公开观测可报名，其余时间经楼下值班人约见。
en_access: Public observations accept bookings each ten-day; otherwise arrange through the duty keeper.

name: 佩弥·烛页

relationships.text: 支持梅洛开放教材，提醒她无钱买纸的人也需要口授与共用本。
relationships.en_text: Supports Melo’s open texts and asks for oral lessons and shared copies for people without paper money.

relationships.text: 教塔莎记账，不把她将来离开客栈当作忘恩。
relationships.en_text: Teaches Tasha bookkeeping without treating a future departure from the inn as ingratitude.

role: 成人识字教师与抄写员
appearance: 旧长袍挽到手肘，指侧布满纸割小痕。
en_appearance: Sleeves rolled to the elbows reveal paper cuts along the fingers.
voice: 不会替学生抢答，急时也保持等候。
en_voice: Never answers for a learner, even when pressed for time.
goal: 拒绝排他捐款，同时找到下一季纸张。
en_goal: Reject exclusionary funding and still secure next season’s paper.
public: 用抄写收入补贴夜课；信任学生，却把自己的饥饿藏得很好。
en_public: Copying work supports evening classes; trusting of learners, secretive about going hungry.
private: 已卖掉一册私人藏书垫薪，担心同事因此过意不去；看到售书账或建立友谊后才说明。
en_private: Sold a cherished book to cover wages; reveals this after a sales record or friendship, fearing colleagues’ guilt.
access: 白日抄写室和课后可见，上课时可安静旁听。
en_access: Available in the copying room or after lessons; visitors may quietly observe class.

name: 伊佐·玻种

relationships.text: 需要诺缇补充野生株系，答应标明来源而非据为自己的培育成果。
relationships.en_text: Needs Noti’s wild stock and credits its origin rather than claiming to have bred it.

relationships.text: 想在苏苓果园试药，承认她有权限制面积并保留不处理的树。
relationships.en_text: Wants trials in Sulin’s orchard and recognizes her right to limit plots and retain untreated trees.

relationships.text: 与艾弥争过一株药草该剪多少，愿先算可用剂量与保种损失。
relationships.en_text: Disputed pruning with Aimi and will compare usable doses with seed-stock loss.

appearance: 玻璃珠串记录花期，掌心有细小烫疤。
en_appearance: Glass beads record flowering cycles; tiny burns mark his palms.
voice: 说到根会蹲下，让听者也看一眼。
en_voice: Crouches when discussing roots so others can see.
goal: 兼顾眼前药材和来年的种株。
en_goal: Balance immediate medicine with next year’s parent plants.
public: 卖苗和维护暖管；反对浪费，有时把稀有品种看得比病人的催促还重。
en_public: Sells seedlings and maintains heating pipes; hates waste but can prioritize rarity over patients’ urgency.
private: 备份种子有一部分未发芽，他尚未告知求药者；共同点检种仓并试种后可核实。
en_private: Some backup seed has failed to sprout; he has not told medicine buyers, and inspection plus germination tests can verify it.
access: 浇水后接待，入棚先清理鞋底且勿碰药株。
en_access: Receives visitors after watering; clean footwear and leave medicinal plants untouched.

name: 娜维·静桨

relationships.text: 理解缇瑟怕鱼坏，愿调次序但不允许她代别人签收。
relationships.en_text: Understands Tisse’s spoilage risk and can reorder unloading, not authorize proxy signatures.

relationships.text: 把封箱运给瓦瑟，要求他安排确实能签收的人而非让船一直等。
relationships.en_text: Carries Vasser’s sealed shipments and requires an actual receiving signatory rather than endless waiting.

appearance: 蓝灰鳞上披防水短袍，腰挂两把形状不同的锁钥。
en_appearance: A waterproof cape covers blue-gray scales; two different lock keys hang at her waist.
voice: 交接时逐字复述，闲谈反而常笑。
en_voice: Repeats handover terms exactly and laughs readily off duty.
goal: 找齐缺失签收，不靠擅开货箱证明清白。
en_goal: Recover missing receipts without opening clients’ cargo.
public: 按航次收费；重隐私，也会因被怀疑而急于替自己辩解。
en_public: Charges per crossing; values privacy but gets defensive under suspicion.
private: 箱子曾在她船上换过外绳，原因是漏雨而不是开封；核对船日志和封蜡后才可判断。
en_private: Replaced outer rope after rain damage, not opening; the boat log and seal examination can establish this.
access: 卸货完成后在渡台接单，不允许借问话摸货箱。
en_access: Takes work after unloading; questions do not authorize handling cargo.

name: 鲁珂·映石

relationships.text: 向梅洛请教公开演示，误以为公开就能省掉监督，已被她纠正。
relationships.en_text: Asked Melo about public demonstrations and was corrected that openness does not remove supervision.

relationships.text: 觉得瓦瑟限制太多，但记得他曾亲自帮自己检查防护线。
relationships.en_text: Finds Vasser restrictive but remembers his personal help inspecting wards.

role: 防护术学徒与试场杂役
appearance: 耳尖留有烧痕，长尾用皮带收好。
en_appearance: Scorched ear tips and a tail secured for work.
voice: 理论讲得很响，承认害怕时会压低声音。
en_voice: Loud about theory, quiet about fear.
goal: 展示能挡碎屑的新护术，并获得正式助教收入。
en_goal: Demonstrate a fragment-stopping ward and earn an assistantship.
public: 靠清理试场抵学费；渴望掌声，也真的会先扶起摔倒的同学。
en_public: Cleans the yard for tuition; hungry for applause but helps fallen classmates first.
private: 新术曾让他短暂耳鸣，他在笔记标了问号；须经自愿讲述或获准阅记录才知道，不能视为已确定后遗症。
en_private: The spell once caused brief ringing in his ears, marked uncertain in notes; voluntary disclosure or authorized access is needed, not a diagnosis by narration.
access: 公开练习可交谈，试验必须先让监督者划安全线。
en_access: Available at public practice; experiments wait for a supervisor’s safety boundary.

name: 菲奥·热饼

relationships.text: 替伊瑟送修屋木料，想借粮库钥匙前先弄清塌方。
relationships.en_text: Delivers repair timber to Ither and wants to inspect collapse risks before borrowing the granary key.

relationships.text: 请乔露安排修门募料摊，答应不占婚礼花摊的位置。
relationships.en_text: Asks Jolu for a repair-donation stall without taking wedding flower space.

role: 街坊修缮召集人与面点师
appearance: 白面沾在黑卷发里，腰上挂小门锤。
en_appearance: Flour in dark curls, a little door hammer at his belt.
voice: 常以一个饼换一句真话，但不强买答案。
en_voice: Offers bread for a truthful word without demanding the answer.
goal: 让城门在寒潮前挡住风，不给任何继承人独占功劳。
en_goal: Seal the gate before cold weather without a claimant monopolizing credit.
public: 卖饼组织轮值；讨厌贵族争名，自己也怕修成后没人记得街坊。
en_public: Bakes and organizes shifts; dislikes noble vanity but fears neighbors’ work being forgotten.
private: 收过一位使者的木料定金，附款含糊；当他愿展示字据时才能讨论是否应退还。
en_private: Accepted a claimant’s timber advance with ambiguous terms; the receipt must be shared before judging repayment.
access: 黎明买饼可见，修缮讨论在午后收摊后。
en_access: At the bread stall at dawn; repair talks follow afternoon closing.

name: 塞维娅·灰页

relationships.text: 向乔文借阅必须登记，不要求他为了档案院威望交出名册所有权。
relationships.en_text: Logs loans from Joven and does not demand ownership for the archive’s prestige.

relationships.text: 愿帮瑟缇比对地契，说明旧所有权记录不能单独决定今天谁搬走。
relationships.en_text: Helps Seti compare deeds and explains that old ownership alone cannot decide present eviction.

appearance: 衣领别细针，眼镜边缘绕棉线防滑。
en_appearance: A fine needle at her collar; cotton secures her spectacles.
voice: 把“记载如此”和“事情如此”分得很开。
en_voice: Carefully distinguishes what a record says from what happened.
goal: 重建矛盾继承文书的保存经过。
en_goal: Reconstruct the custody of conflicting succession documents.
public: 靠修复和检索费维持纸库；愿帮助穷人，却对口述史苛刻得近乎失礼。
en_public: Conservation and search fees fund the archive; helps poor readers but can be rude about oral evidence.
private: 其中一位流亡抄手是她母亲，她从未看见母亲补写争议段；亲属关系需从获准家书确认，不等于共谋。
en_private: One exile copyist was her mother, whom she never saw add the disputed passage; permitted family letters establish kinship, not collusion.
access: 预约检索即可见，原件须在监督下阅看。
en_access: Meet through a research appointment; originals remain supervised.

name: 乔露·五瓣

relationships.text: 喜欢贝珂把交换说清楚，仍会查清他带来的旧花瓶有没有原主来找。
relationships.en_text: Likes Beko’s clear barter terms and checks whether their used vases have claimants.

relationships.text: 认可菲奥真在干活，仍让他的摊与其他人一样按时撤场。
relationships.en_text: Respects Fio’s work and still requires his stall to clear on time like the rest.

appearance: 花篮比肩宽，围裙上画着摊位格。
en_appearance: A shoulder-wide basket and a stall grid drawn on her apron.
voice: 争吵时不加音量，只挪开挡路的花桶。
en_voice: Never raises her voice in a dispute, merely moves obstructing buckets.
goal: 让三场纪念仪式都有位置，也让摊贩当天能营业。
en_goal: Fit three commemorations around a working market day.
public: 卖鲜花兼收清洁费；厌恶站队，却会替卖不掉花的老人占好摊位。
en_public: Sells flowers and collects cleaning fees; rejects factionalism but reserves good places for struggling elders.
private: 她排表时故意错开两位旧仇的相遇，没有篡改仪式内容；经双方同意协调后才解释。
en_private: Scheduled two old enemies apart without altering their ceremonies; explains during mediation with their consent.
access: 白日广场花摊可见，排班表可公开查阅。
en_access: At the flower stall by day; the schedule is public.

name: 缪特·黑芯

relationships.text: 认为贝珂肯保存收据值得合作，也提醒旧货故事不能代替合法来源。
relationships.en_text: Values Beko’s receipts and warns that a charming object story does not establish lawful origin.

relationships.text: 给赫里介绍过合法导路客，不要求他接受每一笔同行委托。
relationships.en_text: Referred lawful guiding clients to Herri without demanding every fellowship job be accepted.

appearance: 黑蜡沾在指缝，外衣漂亮却有暗补。
en_appearance: Black wax between his fingers; a handsome coat with discreet patches.
voice: 一句实话后常跟一句价钱。
en_voice: A price often follows a truth.
goal: 清掉私人债务，保住同行不卖住户钥匙的底线。
en_goal: Clear a private debt while keeping residents’ keys out of trade.
public: 开锁需证明使用权；嘴上只认钱，却会免费修独居人的门。
en_public: Requires proof of authority before opening locks; claims to care only for money yet fixes isolated residents’ doors free.
private: 债主拿着他一次错误引路的赔偿单，不是掌握万能罪证；只有获准看单或他自述才能知道缘由。
en_private: His creditor holds compensation for a mistaken guiding job, not universal blackmail; consented access or disclosure reveals it.
access: 晚间锁铺可约，密谈地点由双方同意。
en_access: Appointments at the lock shop in the evening; private meeting sites need mutual agreement.

name: 阿莎·水阶

relationships.text: 靠伊瑟说明旧厨房排水走向，知道老记忆须与现场勘测互证。
relationships.en_text: Uses Ither’s recollections of kitchen drains and checks them against surveys.

relationships.text: 请多茵远程核一张水压草图，尚未约定她来外城施工。
relationships.en_text: Asks Doyin to review a pressure sketch without presuming she will come build.

appearance: 深绿鳞上留白水线，肩背绕着救生绳。
en_appearance: White waterlines mark dark green scales; rescue rope crosses her shoulders.
voice: 说话先交代出口在哪里。
en_voice: Begins by explaining the exits.
goal: 查清宫底敲击与排水堵塞，免得外城低地被淹。
en_goal: Trace the knocking and blocked drains before the low wards flood.
public: 靠检修旧渠生活；赞成保全遗物，但若要救人愿先打破漂亮石门。
en_public: Maintains old drains; preserves relics but will break a beautiful door to save a life.
private: 她听过敲击节律变化，怀疑是活动闸片而非活人，但未入门查证；看她潜水笔记只能得到此猜测。
en_private: Heard the rhythm change and suspects a moving gate, not a person; her dive notes record a hypothesis only.
access: 低水位时在入口整装，跟潜需技能与安全绳。
en_access: Prepares at the entrance at low water; accompanying dives require skill and a lifeline.

name: 伊瑟婆婆

relationships.text: 给菲奥留锅底豆汤，要求他别把自己的故事讲成贵族的陪衬。
relationships.en_text: Saves soup for Fio and asks him not to make her life a footnote to nobles.

relationships.text: 肯向阿莎讲旧水道，但提醒她如今的堵塞不是自己年轻时见过的状态。
relationships.en_text: Shares old drain memories with Asha and warns today’s blockages differ from her youth.

role: 旧宫灶看守与豆汤厨师
en_role: Keeper of the palace kitchens and soup cook
appearance: 白发编成细圈，围裙里藏着厚旧钥匙。
en_appearance: White hair in a small coil, a heavy old key in her apron.
voice: 不喜欢被叫活史书，喜欢别人问汤够不够咸。
en_voice: Dislikes being called living history; prefers questions about the soup.
goal: 修好漏雨厨房，把祖辈的劳动留在记忆里。
en_goal: Repair the leaking kitchen and preserve servants’ work in memory.
public: 卖廉价豆汤，也教大锅饭；不卖钥匙，但并非永不肯借。
en_public: Sells cheap soup and teaches communal cooking; refuses to sell her key but may lend it.
private: 钥匙通向的粮库早有一半塌了，她怕借钥匙等于害人；帮助查清支撑后才会详细说明。
en_private: Half the granary behind the key has collapsed; she fears a loan could hurt someone and explains after structural help.
access: 午饭前后可帮灶或交谈，不要擅摸她的围裙。
en_access: Help or talk around lunchtime; her apron and key remain hers.

name: 维娅·雾绳

relationships.text: 催塔芙尽快恢复灯光，又知道航图错误不一定是灯塔单方责任。
relationships.en_text: Urges Tavv to restore light while recognizing chart errors may not be the beacon’s fault.

relationships.text: 与蕾弥协商泊地用水和通行，反对把寻人名单变成码头出入证。
relationships.en_text: Negotiates anchorage water and access with Remi without turning tracing lists into entry passes.

appearance: 厚外套永远半湿，腕带缀着各泊位木牌。
en_appearance: A perpetually damp coat; berth markers on her wrist strap.
voice: 一句话能安排三条船，遇丧讯就会停笔。
en_voice: Can dispatch three ships in a sentence, then stops writing for news of a death.
goal: 解释近期偏航，让拥堵不挤掉小渔船生计。
en_goal: Explain recent navigation errors without displacing small fishing boats.
public: 收固定港薪；重效率，却为熟船长破过排位惯例。
en_public: Draws a fixed harbor wage; prizes efficiency but has favored familiar captains.
private: 她压住过一份偏航报告怕引起退运，现留有副本；比对登记时间后方可追问，不知因此究竟损失多少。
en_private: Delayed one deviation report to avoid canceled cargo; registration times reveal the delay, not its total cost.
access: 潮汐间歇在调度棚接待，正在靠泊时只收紧急信息。
en_access: Available between tides; during docking only urgent reports are taken.

name: 塔芙·余光

relationships.text: 请艾洛温先改船员正在用的图，古灯回声的学术讨论可以稍后。
relationships.en_text: Asks Elowen to correct working navigation charts before debating ancient echoes.

relationships.text: 要求维娅把偏航时辰交出来，愿合作但不承担未经核实的全部过错。
relationships.en_text: Requests Veya’s deviation times and will cooperate without accepting every unverified blame.

relationships.text: 请奥瑟解释结绳旧记，也不将祭司信仰当成灯心技术证据。
relationships.en_text: Asks Othe about knot records without treating faith as technical evidence about the core.

en_role: Ancient beacon keeper and lamp maker
appearance: 银须用海蓝绳系住，手持遮光小片。
en_appearance: A sea-blue cord binds silver beard hair; a shutter plate rests in hand.
voice: 每讲一个奇迹就补上一个保养条件。
en_voice: Adds a maintenance requirement to every wonder.
goal: 在恢复航标时尽量留住灯心回声。
en_goal: Restore safe navigation while preserving the core’s echoes where possible.
public: 靠沿海船户分摊和修灯收入生活；敬畏古物，但不愿让船员替古物送命。
en_public: Supported by coastal crews and lamp repairs; reveres relics without sacrificing sailors to them.
private: 已经录下三段不完整回声，其中人名听不清；经允许听录音也不能自动识别说话者或补全古史。
en_private: Recorded three incomplete echoes with unclear names; permitted listening does not identify speakers or complete ancient history.
access: 补给日或午后巡检可上塔，经说明后远离灯心热区。
en_access: Visit on supply days or afternoon inspection; keep clear of the hot core after briefing.

name: 诺姆·盐风

relationships.text: 与赫莎议盐运价，知道车夫也要吃饭，却不肯把全部降价转给盐工。
relationships.en_text: Negotiates salt freight with Hesha, recognizing driver wages without passing all cuts to salt workers.

relationships.text: 请戴鲁修盐场水泵，愿付工钱，不把同属漂泊者当免费互助凭据。
relationships.en_text: Pays Dairu for pump repairs instead of claiming shared displacement means free labor.

en_role: Salt crew leader and boat co-owner
appearance: 帽檐有盐壳，手掌粗得能磨木头。
en_appearance: Salt crust on his hat and wood-rough palms.
voice: 谈工资很硬，催债时声音却轻了。
en_voice: Firm on wages, quieter when collecting debts.
goal: 联合议价但给欠债盐工留下活路。
en_goal: Bargain collectively while keeping indebted workers afloat.
public: 靠盐工资和船分红生活；反对压价，却也收着合伙人欠款。
en_public: Lives on salt wages and boat shares; opposes low prices while collecting partners’ debts.
private: 他的船份可以抵债但会损失晚年收入，他尚未做决定；只向受信任的调停人展示账册。
en_private: Could pledge his boat share against debt at the cost of retirement income; undecided, he shows books only to trusted mediators.
access: 收盐后在风车棚休息，午间强光下不谈长事。
en_access: Rests at the windmill shed after raking; no long talks in midday glare.

name: 蕾弥·缝帆

relationships.text: 肯给维娅不具名的人数估计，不把求助者个人资料拿来换泊位。
relationships.en_text: Offers Veya anonymous headcounts, not personal information in exchange for berths.

relationships.text: 请戴鲁帮搭私密谈话屏风，答应不因他想定居就少给寻亲帮助。
relationships.en_text: Asks Dairu to build interview screens and promises settlement choices will not reduce tracing help.

relationships.text: 愿帮瑟缇寻找旧邻，要求她先说清哪些信件可以转交。
relationships.en_text: Helps Seti find former neighbors and asks which letters may be forwarded.

role: 失散登记协作者与帆布裁缝
en_role: Family tracing volunteer and sailcloth seamstress
appearance: 手腕戴量布绳，衣袋分开装空白与已写姓名条。
en_appearance: A measuring cord at her wrist; blank and completed name slips in separate pockets.
voice: 问姓名之前先问是否愿意留下。
en_voice: Asks permission to record before asking a name.
goal: 帮人找亲人，又让不愿被找到的人能拒绝。
en_goal: Reunite families while protecting those who do not want to be found.
public: 缝帆补棚挣钱；耐心听人倾诉，却不肯轻易谈自己的出身。
en_public: Earns through sails and shelters; listens patiently but avoids her own origins.
private: 她换过姓以避旧雇主，不涉及通缉事实；获她同意才可知旧名，帮助寻亲并不授权公布。
en_private: Changed her surname to avoid an old employer, with no established criminal charge; tracing work does not authorize revealing it.
access: 缝补摊可接洽，寻人谈话在有遮挡的桌边单独进行。
en_access: Contact her at the mending stall; tracing interviews happen privately behind a screen.

name: 赫里·潮扣

relationships.text: 肯教维斯保命结，但不愿被拉去为拆钟作道德担保。
relationships.en_text: Will teach Viss safety knots, not vouch for the ethics of dismantling a bell.

relationships.text: 认识缪特的债务压力，但拒绝用自己知道的避难路线替他换钱。
relationships.en_text: Knows Myut’s debt pressure and refuses to sell refuge routes to repay it.

relationships.text: 曾让奥瑟代写海上失约的道歉信，不愿这段私事成为向导的闲谈价目。
relationships.en_text: Had Othe write an apology for a missed sea meeting and does not sell that private history as guide gossip.

role: 潮洞向导与废索回收者
en_role: Tidal cave guide and rope salvager
appearance: 一只耳朵穿着旧铜扣，膝垫厚得像船板。
en_appearance: An old copper buckle in one ear; kneepads as thick as planks.
voice: 讲笑话缓和紧张，但倒计潮位时绝不玩笑。
en_voice: Jokes to ease fear, never about the tide.
goal: 辨明洞内货物遗痕，避免港工被一网定罪。
en_goal: Trace cargo remains without implicating every dockworker.
public: 收费带路和回收旧索；以前接过来路不明的运货活，如今拒载伤人货。
en_public: Guides and salvages rope for fees; once took dubious cargo, now refuses harmful loads.
private: 认识一枚扣的制作匠，但不知最后持有者；展示实物并保障不乱指控后才引见。
en_private: Recognizes a buckle’s maker, not its final owner; introduces the maker after seeing it and agreeing against unsupported accusations.
access: 退潮前在洞口接客，错过安全窗口就等下一潮。
en_access: Meets clients before low tide; missing the window means waiting.

name: 奥瑟·潮结

relationships.text: 替塔芙召集自愿搬运者，明说祝祷不能保证修灯不出事故。
relationships.en_text: Recruits volunteer carriers for Tavv and states blessings cannot guarantee accident-free repairs.

relationships.text: 知道赫里有可改正的旧事，不把接纳等同于替所有过去担保。
relationships.en_text: Recognizes Herri can make amends without vouching for every past action.

role: 祈潮所祭司与海员识字教师
en_role: Tide shrine priest and sailors’ literacy teacher
appearance: 长袍下穿旧海靴，结绳簿用油布包住。
en_appearance: Old sea boots under his robe; knot records in oilcloth.
voice: 祝祷简短，核人名时耐心到固执。
en_voice: Brief in prayer, stubbornly patient with names.
goal: 弄清冒名结绳的原因，不先把求庇护者赶走。
en_goal: Explain the borrowed name before expelling a possible sanctuary seeker.
public: 收自愿供养并教写信；相信宽恕，却不愿宽恕自己失约的旧事。
en_public: Lives on offerings and letter lessons; believes in forgiveness but denies it to himself.
private: 死者曾是他未能按约接回的船员，尚无证据说明他的失约导致死亡；旧航记经允许阅看才知。
en_private: The dead sailor was someone he failed to meet as promised; no evidence proves this caused the death, and old voyage notes require permission.
access: 非仪式时祈潮台开放，私人名册需说明目的并获许可。
en_access: The shrine is open between rites; personal registers require purpose and permission.

name: 洁珊·双秤

relationships.text: 认为艾汀报损偏少是怕失租，不愿在没有核对前称他造假。
relationships.en_text: Suspects Aytin understated losses from fear of eviction and refuses to label it fraud before checking.

relationships.text: 让赫莎公开运费组成，愿区分路远成本与垄断加价。
relationships.en_text: Asks Hesha to explain freight costs and distinguishes distance from monopoly markup.

relationships.text: 替苏苓估试药期间可能少卖的果量，不承诺补偿一定到位。
relationships.en_text: Estimates Sulin’s trial-related sales loss without promising compensation will arrive.

appearance: 两把小砝码挂在腰间，工作袍沾麦芒。
en_appearance: Two test weights at her waist; chaff on her work coat.
voice: 人人都让她讲公道，她先让秤静下来。
en_voice: Asked for fairness, she first waits for the scale to settle.
goal: 让粮价体现不同村庄的收成与运费。
en_goal: Price grain with villages’ different yields and hauling costs in view.
public: 拿合仓工钱，公开校秤；不许造假，却害怕诚实报告断掉邻村借粮。
en_public: Paid by the union and calibrates publicly; opposes fraud but fears honest reports cutting off a village’s credit.
private: 她有一份未提交的歉收补表，尚未核验最后两户；获准查看也不可当成最终产量。
en_private: Holds an unsubmitted crop-loss supplement with two households unverified; access does not make its figures final.
access: 集日秤台排队可问，复杂账务需收市后。
en_access: Queue at the scale on market days; detailed accounts wait until closing.

name: 阿伦·补旗

relationships.text: 尊重瑟缇保存乡约，争论归乡时提醒她年轻人并非都忘了故乡。
relationships.en_text: Respects Seti’s records and reminds her that choosing settlement is not necessarily forgetting.

relationships.text: 愿支持戴鲁长住租约，哪怕这意味着营里少一位熟练修泵人。
relationships.en_text: Supports Dairu’s long tenancy even if the camp loses a skilled pump repairer.

role: 营地互助召集人与车轮匠
appearance: 灰毛下有一道细伤疤，补旗布用作工具卷。
en_appearance: A fine scar under gray fur; patchbanner cloth wraps his tools.
voice: 不说跟我走，常说你想住在哪里。
en_voice: Rarely says follow me; asks where people want to live.
goal: 让回乡与定居两条路都不以服从为条件。
en_goal: Keep both return and settlement available without demanding obedience.
public: 修轮挣钱、组织共餐；反对强迫归乡，却自己无法想象死在异土。
en_public: Repairs wheels and organizes meals; opposes forced return but cannot imagine dying elsewhere.
private: 他保存的祖地契边界已与现住户菜园重叠；愿比较地图和听双方意见后才出示，不是驱逐许可证。
en_private: His ancestral deed overlaps current gardens; he shows it for joint comparison, not as an eviction license.
access: 白天修轮棚可见，议事在晚饭后自愿参加。
en_access: At the wheel shed by day; evening meetings are voluntary.

name: 苏苓·晴果

relationships.text: 认可伊佐懂植物，也要求他失败时留下记录而非换个药名再试。
relationships.en_text: Respects Izo’s plants and demands records of failure rather than rebranding a treatment.

relationships.text: 信任洁珊不动秤，仍会要求把坏果和好果分开计价。
relationships.en_text: Trusts Jeshan’s scale and asks that damaged and sound fruit be priced separately.

appearance: 发巾印着梨花，袖口插嫁接小刀。
en_appearance: Pear blossoms on her headscarf; a grafting knife at her cuff.
voice: 讨价快，讨论一棵病树会说很久。
en_voice: Quick at bargaining, slow and thorough about a sick tree.
goal: 用小块试验救果园，不把整季押在新药上。
en_goal: Save the orchard through a small trial rather than gambling the season on a new treatment.
public: 卖果和接枝服务；珍惜谨慎，却会因担心失收而催促结果。
en_public: Sells fruit and grafting; values caution but presses for results when harvest is threatened.
private: 她已在一枝树上试过民间配方，可能干扰对照；共同订试验方案时会坦白，不能假装所有树条件相同。
en_private: Tried a folk mixture on one branch, potentially confounding tests; reveals it when planning a trial.
access: 采果时可换工交谈，试药必须征得园主同意。
en_access: Trade work and conversation during picking; treatments require her consent.

name: 格兰·骨渠

relationships.text: 请艾汀用熟悉的田埂标出漏水走向，不要求伤手的人承担重体力。
relationships.en_text: Asks Aytin to map leaks along familiar banks rather than do heavy work with an injured hand.

relationships.text: 请多茵评估渠首改线，愿共享测量而不让她替龙骨真假背书。
relationships.en_text: Asks Doyin about rerouting and shares measurements without demanding a verdict on dragon bones.

appearance: 浅骨色鳞片，腰间挂一把比剑还旧的扳手。
en_appearance: Bone-pale scales; a wrench older than many swords at his waist.
voice: 对龙传说不置气，但会问传说能不能堵漏。
en_voice: Untroubled by dragon legends, asks whether they can stop a leak.
goal: 修住渠首而不靠卖支撑水路的骨头筹钱。
en_goal: Seal the headgate without selling the bones supporting it.
public: 受各村分摊雇用；不愿因族属被奉成祖灵解释者，又暗自好奇骨的来历。
en_public: Paid jointly by villages; rejects being treated as an ancestry oracle yet is curious about the bones.
private: 他保存一片自然脱落的碎屑，未能确定材质；允许鉴定才能新增认识，不预设真龙遗骸。
en_private: Kept a naturally shed fragment of unidentified material; only examination can add knowledge, not presume a dragon.
access: 停水维护时可近闸，放水时在岸上等他。
en_access: Approach during shutdown maintenance; wait ashore while water runs.

name: 温娅·风铃

relationships.text: 与卡鲁互通失马消息，要求巡骑别因恐吓信把兽裔伙伴排除在巡队外。
relationships.en_text: Exchanges horse reports with Karru and rejects removing beastkin partners over the threat letter.

relationships.text: 请梅荻辨认夜路牧群足迹，不把牧民进入高地自动视为越界。
relationships.en_text: Asks Medi about herd tracks without presuming highland grazing is trespass.

role: 夜巡领队与铃铛修理人
en_role: Night patrol leader and chime repairer
appearance: 耳边有细铜屑，巡夜披风内侧缝反光贝片。
en_appearance: Copper filings near her ears; reflective shell patches inside her patrol cloak.
voice: 先听脚步再问来客；说笑很干。
en_voice: Listens to footsteps before questioning visitors; dry humor.
goal: 查清恐吓信，维持共同巡路而不扩大猜疑。
en_goal: Trace the threat letter while preserving the mixed patrol.
public: 靠修铃与巡夜补贴生活；说人人同等，却对自己的亲戚格外难下判断。
en_public: Lives on repairs and patrol allowance; insists on equality but struggles to judge kin.
private: 信的折法像她表弟惯用方式，只是弱线索；她会在可靠调查者承诺不先定罪后说明。
en_private: The fold resembles her cousin’s habit, a weak clue; tells a careful investigator who will not prejudge guilt.
access: 傍晚集合点可谈，陪巡需同意不擅追人。
en_access: At evening muster; companions must agree not to chase independently.

name: 贝琳·春雪

relationships.text: 愿为杜埃的低扰动采法调整订单，但不能把未经检验的盐直接配药。
relationships.en_text: Will adapt orders to Due’s gentler methods but will not use untested salt in medicine.

relationships.text: 提醒艾弥休息是照护的一部分，愿重排夜班但不能凭空增加药。
relationships.en_text: Tells Aimi rest is part of care; can change shifts but cannot create extra medicine.

relationships.text: 请赫莎运盐和酒精，愿付真实成本，不要求车队以善名承担全部开支。
relationships.en_text: Asks Hesha to carry salt and spirits and pays real costs rather than demanding charity by reputation.

appearance: 厚围裙洗得褪色，胸前吊药匙而非徽章。
en_appearance: A faded apron; a medicine spoon hangs where a badge might.
voice: 先问能吃下什么，再问来意。
en_voice: Asks what someone can eat before asking their business.
goal: 补足盐与酒精，守住按病情分药的做法。
en_goal: Replenish salt and spirits while allocating by clinical need.
public: 靠同工供养、制剂和教学维持药房；温和接人，对插队捐助者十分冷硬。
en_public: Maintains the dispensary through community support, preparations and teaching; gentle to visitors, stern with donors seeking priority.
private: 她留了少量急救储备而未公开数量，怕被抢购；获授权盘药者才可知，不是无限药源。
en_private: Keeps a small emergency reserve with undisclosed quantity; authorized stocktaking reveals a finite supply.
access: 问诊后在药房外谈，病人档案与诊疗空间保持私密。
en_access: Speak outside the dispensary after consultations; patient records and treatment space stay private.

name: 哈伦·桥钉

relationships.text: 常当面批评玛蕾省错地方，但知道她也在筹学徒工资，不愿让流言代替争论。
relationships.en_text: Accuses Marelle of saving in the wrong places, while knowing she seeks apprentice wages; wants argument rather than rumor.

relationships.text: 想先结清芙岚的工餐账，怕她一旦停供，工人以为她而非镇里亏待人。
relationships.en_text: Wants to settle Furran’s meal bill so any stoppage is not wrongly blamed on her.

relationships.text: 需要欧沙的船运支架，已经答应把长木扎好，免得再次撞她船底。
relationships.en_text: Needs Osha’s ferry for supports and promised to lash long timbers clear of her hull.

relationships.text: 欣赏萨蕾温亲自动手，不愿自己的外来身份被拿来当压倒她的理由。
relationships.en_text: Admires Sarewyn’s practical work and refuses to let outsider prestige override her.

appearance: 眉毛缺一角，拇指常套试钉铜环。
en_appearance: A gap in one brow; a copper nail gauge over his thumb.
voice: 不爱演讲，爱把坏钉放到桌上。
en_voice: Prefers putting a bad nail on the table to making speeches.
goal: 修好桥腹裂缝，保住学徒的薪水和手指。
en_goal: Repair the underside crack and protect apprentices’ wages and fingers.
public: 按工程领薪，愿教基础木石工；骂镇长节省，却会自己赊材料。
en_public: Paid for projects and teaches basic building; scolds the mayor’s thrift but buys supplies on credit himself.
private: 桥腹一段裂缝比公开告示严重，他暂用支架稳住；同行实检后才可确认等级，不能仅凭传言宣称桥将塌。
en_private: One crack is worse than the notice says but temporarily shored; inspection establishes severity, not rumors of imminent collapse.
access: 早晨桥工棚集合，桥下施工需护绳且经他同意。
en_access: At the bridge shed in the morning; work underneath needs a lifeline and his permission.

name: 塔莎·麻绳

relationships.text: 感激芙岚给工钱而非只给施舍；希望将来以洗衣生意合作，不必永远做帮工。
relationships.en_text: Values wages rather than charity from Furran; hopes to become a laundry partner, not a permanent helper.

relationships.text: 信任佩弥不会拿自己写错字取笑，愿帮书院洗桌布抵部分学料。
relationships.en_text: Trusts Pemi not to mock mistakes and offers tablecloth washing toward materials.

role: 客栈跑堂与互助送餐人
en_role: Inn server and mutual-aid meal runner
appearance: 长耳束在头巾里，托盘边刻记账点。
en_appearance: Long ears tucked into a scarf; tally marks on her tray.
voice: 送菜很响亮，拒绝无礼要求时反而平静。
en_voice: Calls dishes loudly and refuses disrespect calmly.
goal: 攒钱租自己的洗衣院，同时让暂住者吃到热饭。
en_goal: Save for her own laundry yard while feeding temporary residents.
public: 靠工钱与洗衣挣钱；愿助人，却拒绝被称为永远欠恩的难民。
en_public: Earns wages and laundry money; helpful but rejects permanent indebtedness as a refugee.
private: 她每周留两晚学写账，并不想让掌柜以为要马上离职；经她主动邀请才可旁听。
en_private: Studies bookkeeping twice a week and fears her keeper assuming an immediate departure; lessons are shared only by invitation.
access: 饭后在洗衣棚接洗衣活，值工时不跟陌生人远行。
en_access: Takes laundry after meals; does not leave a shift with strangers.

name: 索缇·细账

relationships.text: 相信特温能认出旧票格式，希望他别把未登记与实际失窃当成同一件事。
relationships.en_text: Trusts Tewin on old receipt formats and wants missing records distinguished from stolen goods.

relationships.text: 尊重蕾萨愿削自己卫队份额，但提醒她计划未执行前不能算作已经节粮。
relationships.en_text: Respects Ressa’s proposed guard cuts but will not count them as savings before implementation.

relationships.text: 担心伊芮急于安葬会丢掉辨认线索，却愿共同保存衣物和位置记录。
relationships.en_text: Fears hurried burial may lose clues and agrees to preserve clothing and location records with Irei.

appearance: 眼镜用细链固定，外套一边肩膀磨得发白。
en_appearance: Fine chains secure spectacles; one coat shoulder is worn pale.
voice: 会把“没有”细分成没到、没记和真没有。
en_voice: Distinguishes absent, unrecorded and never supplied.
goal: 查清缺粮账，不让军户承担所有误差。
en_goal: Reconcile grain shortages without charging households for every discrepancy.
public: 领固定薪水并帮军属代写信；信任书面，遇到真实饥饿仍会破例先发粮后补账。
en_public: Salaried and writes families’ letters; trusts records but sometimes feeds the hungry before paperwork.
private: 一次先发粮的数量由记忆补写，可能误差两袋；需对存粮和收粮者自愿证言核验。
en_private: Reconstructed one emergency issue from memory, possibly two sacks out; stock and voluntary recipient testimony can check it.
access: 午后军需窗可咨询，调阅具名领粮册须正当理由。
en_access: Questions at the afternoon supply window; named issue records require a legitimate reason.

name: 艾梵·窄盾

relationships.text: 很想得到布洛一句称赞，正在学着把安全护送当成比演武胜负更大的本事。
relationships.en_text: Craves Brullo’s praise and is learning that safe escort matters more than winning a display.

relationships.text: 佩服卡鲁照顾老马，试着学兽医剪的用途，而非只问骑枪技巧。
relationships.en_text: Admires Karru’s old-horse care and asks about the shears as well as the lance.

appearance: 盾比同伴窄，靴面擦得过分亮。
en_appearance: A narrower shield than his peers; obsessively polished boots.
voice: 开口先说我能，后来才问怎么做。
en_voice: Says I can before asking how.
goal: 赢得一次可靠护送的评价，而不只赢演武喝彩。
en_goal: Earn praise for a dependable escort rather than a showy duel.
public: 以轮值换训练和食宿；痛恨被低估，也容易低估安静的同伴。
en_public: Trades duty for training and board; hates being underestimated and does it to quiet peers.
private: 他在一次练习中明明听见停手却迟了一拍，正在私下向伤者道歉；不是初见自动获知的丑闻。
en_private: Reacted late to a stop signal and is privately apologizing to the injured partner; this is not public gossip on arrival.
access: 公开操练结束后可约切磋，须接受教头监督和停手规则。
en_access: Spar after public drills with supervision and stop rules.

name: 涅拉·赤炉

relationships.text: 依赖赫德兰熟悉旧契，却要他正面回答工人何时拿到欠薪。
relationships.en_text: Needs Hedran’s covenant knowledge and demands a direct wage-payment answer.

relationships.text: 知道凯莎夹在产量与工人之间，愿谈停工补贴但需要共同算清费用。
relationships.en_text: Recognizes Kaisha’s production conflict and will discuss shutdown support with clear costs.

relationships.text: 愿看提路完整勘测，尚未答应投资或放弃轨道产权。
relationships.en_text: Will review Tiru’s complete survey, without yet promising funds or surrendering rail rights.

appearance: 礼服外罩旧矿衣，发辫嵌一枚粗铁片。
en_appearance: An old mining coat over formal clothes; raw iron in her braid.
voice: 很会说我们，却会被追问这个我们包括谁。
en_voice: Often says we, and is challenged on whom that includes.
goal: 证明扩井能养人，若算不清便宁可推迟继承庆典。
en_goal: Prove expansion can support people, or postpone her succession celebration.
public: 分管采购与家产；愿听工人发言，又本能觉得祖产应由自己最后决定。
en_public: Handles purchasing and assets; hears workers but instinctively claims final say over ancestral property.
private: 她已用个人首饰担保一批风轮备件，尚未通知家族；核对授权采购单后可知，不意味着备件已经到货。
en_private: Pledged personal jewelry for fan spares without telling the house; purchase authorization proves the order, not delivery.
access: 议厅午后采购会可申请列席，私室另约。
en_access: Request a place at afternoon purchasing sessions; private rooms need appointments.

name: 博岑·煤掌

relationships.text: 佩服多茵懂工程，但要求她让不识图的家属也知道何时能喝净水。
relationships.en_text: Respects Doyin’s engineering and wants plain water-service dates for families who cannot read plans.

relationships.text: 愿与赫德兰谈分期，只要同伴听得懂条款且没有替他们私下签字。
relationships.en_text: Will discuss installments with Hedran if workers understand and no one signs for them privately.

relationships.text: 承认凯莎会下井救人，仍坚持救人的勇敢不能替代提前停工。
relationships.en_text: Acknowledges Kaisha’s rescues but says courage cannot replace stopping unsafe work.

role: 矿工推举代表与夜班支架工
en_role: Elected miners’ delegate and night-shift shorer
appearance: 指节宽大，工作靴一只是借来的。
en_appearance: Broad knuckles and one borrowed work boot.
voice: 开会会结巴，说支架受力却清清楚楚。
en_voice: Stammers in meetings, precise about support loads.
goal: 把工伤照料和停工工资写进新约。
en_goal: Secure injury care and shutdown wages in the new agreement.
public: 靠夜班工资养家；鼓励同伴开口，却常替胆小的人抢说。
en_public: Supports a household on night wages; encourages others but speaks over the timid.
private: 妻子有离开矿城的工作机会，他没告诉同伴，怕被看成临阵退缩；只在私人信任下谈。
en_private: His wife has work elsewhere and he fears appearing to desert the miners; shares this only in confidence.
access: 白天休班后在工人茶棚约见，不能打断他必要睡眠。
en_access: Meet at the workers’ tea shed after daytime rest, not during needed sleep.

name: 梅洛·散页

relationships.text: 把缇瑟视为水路经验合作者而非免费样本来源，争论时也照付船费。
relationships.en_text: Treats Tisse as an expert collaborator, not free samples, and pays boat fees even amid disagreement.

relationships.text: 向佩弥借过通俗讲义，承认教得懂与写得准是两门不同本事。
relationships.en_text: Borrowed Pemi’s plain-language lessons and recognizes accuracy and teachability as different skills.

relationships.text: 愿帮鲁珂写清试验说明，拒绝用他的冒险作为开放知识的宣传。
relationships.en_text: Helps Ruko explain tests and refuses to turn his risk-taking into publicity for openness.

role: 开放抄本倡议者与水测讲师
appearance: 衣袋露出不同学生的抄页，鞋上总有湖泥。
en_appearance: Students’ pages protrude from pockets; lake mud on her shoes.
voice: 会请渔人纠正她的例子。
en_voice: Invites fishers to correct her examples.
goal: 让测水方法公开，危险步骤附上足够训练与保护。
en_goal: Open water-testing methods with training and safeguards for hazardous steps.
public: 靠讲课与测水委托生活；主张公开，却没总能算入穷人购买器材的成本。
en_public: Lives on lectures and surveys; favors access but underestimates equipment costs for poorer learners.
private: 她的一版简化说明漏过废液处理，已写更正却尚未送到全部读者；查版本可发现，不等于已有人中毒。
en_private: An abridged guide omitted waste handling; a correction has not reached all readers, with no established poisoning.
access: 鱼市旁公开测水桌可交流，实验要按现场安全安排。
en_access: Talk at the public testing table beside the fish market; experiments follow site precautions.

name: 瓦瑟·封匣

relationships.text: 要求艾洛温更正航图，也反对因一次抄错便否定他全部观测。
relationships.en_text: Demands Elowen’s chart correction without discarding all his observations over one copied digit.

relationships.text: 信任娜维不擅开箱，却要查清签收断在哪一环，不让信任代替核验。
relationships.en_text: Trusts Navi’s discretion but will trace the missing receipt instead of using trust as proof.

relationships.text: 认可鲁珂的想法有价值，要求逐步测试而不是一场证明全部。
relationships.en_text: Values Ruko’s idea and requires staged tests rather than one all-proving demonstration.

appearance: 暗紫鳞，钥匙分别缝在三个内袋里。
en_appearance: Dark purple scales; keys sewn into three separate inner pockets.
voice: 拒绝时会给理由，但理由常长得令人烦躁。
en_voice: Explains refusals, often at exasperating length.
goal: 建立按风险开放的抄本制度，不把封存变成家族特权。
en_goal: Make manuscript access proportionate to risk rather than inherited privilege.
public: 以校勘和保管薪水生活；反对草率传播，也承认封存让自己掌握权力。
en_public: Paid for collation and custody; opposes careless dissemination and recognizes his own power in restriction.
private: 他曾因判断过严延误一次安全水泵维修，留下匿名申诉；合法阅到申诉并询问后才会解释。
en_private: An overly strict judgment delayed a safe pump repair; an anonymous complaint and a fair inquiry reveal it.
access: 书库咨询时段可问学习路径，封匣需逐案许可。
en_access: During archive consultations, ask about study routes; sealed items need case-specific permission.

name: 瑟缇·归土

relationships.text: 起初觉得欧瑞娅阻拦归乡，听过混居旧事后开始问能否做双份记录。
relationships.en_text: First saw Oreya as blocking return; after shared-settlement stories, asks for two sets of records.

relationships.text: 感谢塞维娅保全纸契，也坚持活着的老邻人有权补充纸上遗漏。
relationships.en_text: Values Sevia’s conservation and insists living neighbors can supply what paper omitted.

relationships.text: 觉得蕾弥的保密习惯起初生疏，后来主动给家书分别标注可分享与不可分享。
relationships.en_text: Initially found Remi’s privacy habits unfamiliar, then began marking which letters could be shared.

relationships.text: 认为阿伦太会替各方留余地，却知道他自己也盼着回去。
relationships.en_text: Thinks Aren leaves too much room for every side and knows he personally longs to return.

role: 乡约保存者与种袋缝工
en_role: Village covenant keeper and seed-bag sewer
appearance: 旧村地图缝在大衣内衬，针筒戴在食指。
en_appearance: An old village map in her coat lining; a needle tube on one finger.
voice: 提归乡时坚定，听年轻人说安居时会沉默很久。
en_voice: Firm on returning home, long silent when younger people want to stay.
goal: 保存旧村土地与亲属记忆，不逼人用现在的生活偿还过去。
en_goal: Preserve old land and kinship records without demanding present lives as payment.
public: 缝种袋自养并誊地契；主张归还祖地，又珍惜现住户给她寄的果干。
en_public: Sews seed bags and copies deeds; wants ancestral land restored yet treasures dried fruit sent by its current occupants.
private: 她与现住祖屋的家庭持续通信，信里已有共住建议；须双方许可才分享家书。
en_private: Corresponds with the family in her former home, including a proposal to share; letters require both sides’ permission.
access: 午后共餐棚边做针线，可听故事但抄录先问她。
en_access: Sews near the meal shelter in the afternoon; ask before recording her stories.

name: 戴鲁·新岸

relationships.text: 珍惜诺姆肯按手艺付费，提醒盐场泵不能直接当饮用水泵。
relationships.en_text: Values Nom’s payment for skill and warns saltwork pumps are not automatically potable-water pumps.

relationships.text: 支持蕾弥问名先问意愿，拒绝别人替自己把住址写进公开名册。
relationships.en_text: Supports Remi’s consent-first approach and refuses unapproved publication of his address.

relationships.text: 感谢阿伦不以援助换归乡承诺，愿按能力继续送修理工具。
relationships.en_text: Values Aren’s unconditional aid and keeps contributing tools as able.

appearance: 肩背窄却结实，头巾缝了一枚新的家门牌。
en_appearance: Narrow sturdy shoulders; a new house-number patch on his scarf.
voice: 说到新家会用现在时，不用暂时。
en_voice: Speaks of his new home in the present, not as temporary.
goal: 获得稳固的净水点和长住租约。
en_goal: Secure a reliable water point and long-term tenancy.
public: 修泵谋生，也参与找人；愿保存故乡记忆，拒绝把定居视为背叛。
en_public: Repairs pumps and helps tracing; honors his past without calling settlement betrayal.
private: 他有一张旧雇主介绍信，可能换来远地好工作，尚未决定离开；只在求职求助时分享。
en_private: Has an employer’s letter that may secure distant work but has not decided to leave; shares it when seeking job help.
access: 水桶队散去后可在泵棚谈，修理紧急漏水时请先帮忙或等待。
en_access: Talk at the pump shed after water queues clear; during leaks help or wait.

name: 艾弥·夜灯

relationships.text: 愿给梅荻的牧户教急救，也明确羊病需要另请有经验的兽医。
relationships.en_text: Offers first aid to Medi’s households and says the goats need a veterinary practitioner.

relationships.text: 理解伊佐为来年留种，但请他亲听当前患者的需求，而非只看产量。
relationships.en_text: Understands Izo’s future seed needs and asks him to hear current care needs as well as yield figures.

relationships.text: 支持贝琳按病情分药，提醒她讲清理由能减少家属误解。
relationships.en_text: Supports Belin’s need-based allocation and asks for explanations that families can understand.

appearance: 短角包软布防碰病人，灯架固定在腰侧。
en_appearance: Soft cloth covers short antlers; a lamp bracket sits at her hip.
voice: 解释风险时很直，换药时会轻声问疼不疼。
en_voice: Direct about risks, softly asks about pain while dressing wounds.
goal: 把有限药材用在最有机会受益的人身上，并照顾照护者。
en_goal: Use scarce medicine where it can help and care for carers too.
public: 拿修院津贴也教急救；能劝别人休息，却难承认自己手已发抖。
en_public: Receives a hospice stipend and teaches first aid; urges others to rest but hides her own trembling hands.
private: 她准备暂停夜班，担心同工负担变重；本人愿谈才可知道，不能把疲劳诊断成特定疾病。
en_private: Plans to pause night shifts and worries about colleagues; disclosure is hers, and fatigue does not establish a diagnosis.
access: 公开急救课后可约，诊室内不接受与当次照护无关的询问。
en_access: Arrange talks after public first-aid lessons; treatment rooms are not for unrelated questions.

name: 赫莎·四轮

relationships.text: 肯让特温核原票，但要求按时归还，车不能因文书争议无限等候。
relationships.en_text: Allows Tewin to inspect the original but needs it returned before paperwork stalls her wagons indefinitely.

relationships.text: 以前嫌瑟梨夜班要求麻烦，如今尝试把她安排在已有护送的车次。
relationships.en_text: Once found Serri’s night conditions inconvenient; now tries to place her on escorted departures.

relationships.text: 愿给诺姆算满载与回程两种价，不会承诺每趟都亏钱运。
relationships.en_text: Offers Nom loaded and return-leg prices without promising loss-making trips every time.

relationships.text: 同意洁珊复核秤重，反对把车轮维修费说成没有根据的加价。
relationships.en_text: Accepts Jeshan’s weight checks and defends wheel maintenance as a real cost.

relationships.text: 尊重贝琳不让捐助插队，愿谈回程低价，但先算易燃货的安全装载。
relationships.en_text: Respects Belin’s refusal of donor priority and considers cheap return carriage after planning safe loading for spirits.

appearance: 晒黑的手臂布满绳印，账袋比钱袋旧。
en_appearance: Rope marks on sun-darkened arms; her ledger pouch older than her purse.
voice: 把亏多少钱说清楚，再谈能否讲人情。
en_voice: States the loss before discussing favors.
goal: 把盐、纸和药按约送到，又不让司机连夜冒险。
en_goal: Deliver salt, paper and medicine on terms that do not force drivers through unsafe nights.
public: 自有四辆车但只雇两位车夫；重信用，也承认善举不能永远靠别人赔钱。
en_public: Owns four wagons with two hired drivers; values promises without making others subsidize every good deed.
private: 一份旧护送合同有可协商的空车返程条款，可用于低价救济运货；查看她愿提供的合同副本才知。
en_private: An old escort contract has a negotiable empty-return clause that could carry low-cost aid; her shared copy reveals the option.
access: 集市停车处收单，长途随行须先谈位置、货重与费用。
en_access: Takes orders at the market wagon ground; travel requires agreed seats, weight and cost.
